G3400.def: a Roman mile, milliarium , = 1000 paces,= 8 stades, = 1680 yards, i. e. 80 yards less than our mile, (Polybius Historicus), etc. (ML)

G3401.def:
μιμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(μῖμος, a mimic, an actor), [in LXX: Sl 31:6, Wis.4:2 15:9, 4Ma.9:23 4Mac 9:13 : * ;]
to imitate: 2Ts 3:7 3:9 Hb 13:7, 3Jn.11.†
(AS)

G3402.def:
μιμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(μιμέομαι),
in NT always (like the verb) in good sense, an imitator: 1Co 4:16 11:1, Ef 5:1, 1Ts 1:6 2:14, Hb 6:12.†
(AS)

G3403.def:
μιμνήσκω
(Bl., -ῄ-, § 3, 3), [in LXX chiefly for זָכַר ;]
to remind: mid, and pass.;
__(a) reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember: with genitive of thing(s), Mt 26:75, Lc 1:54, 72 24:8, At 11:16, 2Pe 3:2, Ju 17; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, Hb 8:12 10:17" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s), Lc 23:42; before ὅτι, Mt 5:23 27:63, Lc 16:25, Jo 2:17, 22 12:16; ὡς, Lc 24:6; pf., μέμνημι, in Pres. sense (cl.), with genitive of person(s) (of thing(s)), 1Co 11:2, 2Tm 1:4; pres., μιμνήσκομαι (only in late writers), with genitive of person(s), in sense of caring for, Hb 2:6 (LXX) Hb 13:3;
__(b) in passive sense, to be remembered, aor., ἐμνήσθην : before ἐνώπιον, with genitive of person(s) (cf. Eze.18:22), At 10:31, Ap 16:19 (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπ-ανα-, ὑπο- μιμνήσκω. The tenses of this verb are from the older μνάομαι).†
(AS)

G3404.def:
μισέω, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂנֵא ;]
to hate: with accusative of person(s) Mt 5:43 24:10, Lc 1:71 6:22, 27 19:14, Jo 7:7 15:18-19, 23-26 17:14, Tt 3:3, 1Jo 2:9 Jn 2:11 Jn 3:13 Jn 3:15 Jn 4:20 Ap 17:16; pass., Mt 10:22 24:9, Mc 13:13, Lc 21:17; with accusative of thing(s), Jo 3:20, Rm 7:15, Ef 5:29, Hb 1:9, Ju 23, Ap 2:6; pass., Ap 18:2. As the Heb. שָׂנֵא is sometimes found with the modified sense of indifference to or relative disregard for one thing in comparison with another (cf. Gn 29:30-31, Dt 21:15-16, Ml 1:3) so prob. μ. in the foll.: Mt 6:24, Lc 14:26 16:13, Jo 12:25, Rm 9:13" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3405.def:
μισθαποδοσία, -ας, ἡ
(μισθός, ἀποδίδωμι; cl. μισθοδοσία),
pay­ment of wages, recompense; meton.,
__(a) of reward: Hb 10:35 11:26;
__(b) of punishment : Hb 2:2.†
(AS)

G3406.def:
μισθ-απο-δότης, -ου, ὁ
(see supr.),
one who pays wages; meton., a rewarder: Hb 11:6.†
(AS)

G3407.def:
μίσθιος, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον), [in LXX: Lv 19:13 A Lv 25:50, Jó 7:1 (שָׂכִיר), Tob.5:11, Sir.7:10 31:22 37:11 * ;]
hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant: Lc 15:17, 19 15:21 (Anth., Plut.).†
(AS)

G3408.def:
μισθός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂכָר ;]
__1. prop., wages, hire: Mt 20:8, Lc 10:7, Rm 4:4, 1Tm 5:18, Tg 5:4, Ju 11; μ. ἀδικίας, At 1:18, 2Pe 2:13 (but see Mayor and ICC, in l), 2Pe 2:15.
__2. Generally, reward: Jo 4:36, 1Co 9:18; esp. of divine rewards, Mt 5:12 6:1-2, 5 6:16 10:41-42 Mc 9:41, Lc 6:23, 35, 1Co 3:8 3:14, 2Jn.8, Ap 11:18 22:12; ἔχειν μ., Mt 5:46, 1Co 9:17.†
(AS)

G3409.def:
μισθόω, -ῶ
(μισθός) [in LXX (mid.) chiefly for שָׂכָר ;]
to let out for hire. Mid., to hire: with accusative, Mt 20:1, 7.†
(AS)

G3410.def:
μίσθωμα, -τος, τό
(μισθόω), [in LXX: Dt 23:18 (19), Mq 1:7, Eze.16:31, 34 16:41 (אֶתְנַן), Eze.16:33, (נֵדֶה, נָדָן), Eze.16:32, Pv 19:13 * ;]
__1. price, hire (cl, and LXX).
__2. In sense not found elsewhere, a hired dwelling: At 28:30.†
(AS)

G3411.def:
μισθωτός, -ή, όν
(μισθόω), [in LXX for שָׂכִיר, Êx 12:45, al. ;]
hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant, hireling: Mc 1:20, Jo 10:12-13.†
(AS)

G3412.def:
Μιτυλήνη, -ης, ἡ
(late form - Strab., Plut. - of cl. Μυτιλ-),
Mytilene, Mitylene, chief city of Lesbos: At 20:14.†
(AS)

G3413.def:
Μιχαήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִיכָאֵל, who like God?),
Michael, the Archangel (cf. Dn 12:1) : Ju 9, Ap 12:7.†
(AS)

G3414.def:
μνᾶ, -ᾶς, ἡ
(a Semitic word; cf. Heb. מָנֶה, Aram. מְנֵא, a weight and a sum of money = 100 shekels, cf. 3Ki.10:17),
a mina (Let.), mna, in Attic a weight and sum of money = 100 δραχμαί (which see) : Lc 19:13, 16 19:18, 20 19:24-25.†
(AS)

G3417.def:
μνεία, -ας, ἡ
(μιμνήσκω), [in LXX for זָכַר, its parts and deriva­tives ;]
remembrance, mention (= μνήμη) : Fp 1:3; μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive of person(s), Rm 1:9, Ef 1:16, 1Ts 1:2, Phm 4 (cf. Sl 111:4); μ. ἔχειν, with genitive of person(s), 1Ts 3:6, 2Tm 1:3 (on the seel. in Rm 12:13, see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163).†
(AS)

G3418.def:
μνῆμα, -τος, τό
(μνάομαι), [in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;]
__1. a memorial.
__2. a sepulchral monument, a sepulchre, tomb: Mc 5:3, 5 15:46 16:2 (WH, μνημεῖον), Lc 8:27 23:53 24:1, At 2:29 7:16, Ap 11:9.†
SYN.: μνημεῖον (AS)

G3419.def:
μνημεῖον, -ου, τό
[in LXX for קֶבֶר, קְבוּרָה ;]
__1. a memorial, record (cl., cf. Wis.10:7).
__2. (a) (cl.) a monument: Lc 11:47;
__(b) a sepulchre, tomb (Gn 23:6, 9, Is 22:16, al.): Mt 23:29, Mc 5:2, Lc 11:44, Jo 5:28, and frequently in Gospels, At 13:29
SYN.: μνῆμα (AS)

G3420.def:
μνήμη, -ης, ἡ
(μνάομαι), [in LXX for זֵכֶר, זִכְרוֹן ;]
memory, remembrance, mention: μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive, to remember, 2Pe 1:15 (but in cl., π., μ. π. more frequently = to make mention, and so perh. here, cf. Mayor, in l; and for ex. from π., see Zorell, see word).†
SYN.: μνεία, q.v (AS)

G3421.def:
μνημονεύω
(μνήμων, mindful) [in LXX for זָכַר ;]
__1. to call to mind, remember : absol., Mc 8:18; with genitive of person(s), Lc 17:32, Cl 4:18, 1Ts 1:3, Hb 11:15 (but see infr.) Hb 13:7; τ. πτωχῶν, Gl 2:20; with genitive of thing(s), Jo 15:20 16:4, 21, At 20:35; with accusative obj. (as more frequently in cl.), of persons, 2Tm 2:8; of things, Mt 16:9, 1Ts 2:9, Ap 18:5; before ὅτι, At 20:31, Ef 2:11, 2Ts 2:5; πόθεν, Ap 2:5; πῶς, Ap 3:3.
__2. to make mention of: with genitive, Hb 11:15 (but see supr., and cf. M, Th., I, 18); before περί, Hb 11:22.†
(AS)

G3422.def:
μνημόσυνον, -ου, τό
(μνήμων, mindful), [in LXX frequently for זֵכֶר, זִכְרוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
a memorial: Mt 26:13, Mc 14:9, At 10:4 (where cf. Lv 2:9, 16 5:12, Num_5:28, Sir.45:16, al.).†
(AS)

G3423.def:
μνηστεύω
[in LXX for אָרַשׂ pi., pu. ;]
__1. to woo and win, espouse.
__2. to promise in marriage, betroth; pass., of the woman, to be be­trothed: with dative of person(s), Mt 1:18, Lc 1:27 2:5.†
(AS)

G3424.def:
μογι-λάλος, -ον
(μόγις, λάλος), [in LXX: Is 35:6 (אִלֵּם) * ;]
speaking with difficulty: Mc 7:32 (Tr., txt., μογγιλάλος, thick-voiced, see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G3425.def:
μόγις
adv. (μόγος, toil), [in LXX: Wis.9:16 א A (μόγις, B), 3Ma.7:6 * ;]
with toil or difficulty, hardly: Lc 9:39 (μόγις, WH).†
(AS)

G3426.def:
μοιχαλίς, -ίδος, ἡ
(= Att.. μοιχάς, fem. of μοιχός), [in LXX: Pv 18:22 30:20), Eze.16:38 23:45, Os 3:1, Ml 3:5 (נַאֲפוּף, נָאַף) * ;]
an adulteress: Rm 7:3; meton., for μοιχεία, 2Pe 2:14. Metaphorical, of infidelity to God (cf. Eze.16:15 ff. Eze.23:43 ff., al.), Tg 4:4; as an adj., Mt 12:39 16:4, Mc 8:8.†
(AS)

G3428.def:
1. an adulteress , (New Testament):as adjective adulterous , (New Testament)
2. as Substantive = μοιχεία, (New Testament) (ML)

G3429.def:
μοιχάω, -ῶ
(= cl. μοιχεύω), [in LXX (mid., absol. and with accusative, with party of either sex as subj.) : Jr 3:8 5:7 7:9 9:2 23:14 29:23, Eze.16:32 23:37, 43 (נָאַף) * ;]
to commit adultery with: with accusative, fem. In NT always mid, in same sense; of the man : absol., Mt 5:32 19:9 (WH, txt., R, mg., om.); before ἐπ᾽ αὐτήν, Mc 10:11; of the woman: Mc 10:12.†
(AS)

G3430.def:
μοιχεία, -ας, ἡ
(μοιχύω), [rn LXX: Os 2:2 (נַאֲפוּף), Os 4:2 (נָאַף), Jr 13:27 (נִאֻף), Wis.14:26 * ;]
adultery: Jo 8:3; pl. (see WM, 220; Bl., § 32, 6), Mt 15:19, Mc 7:21,†
(AS)

G3431.def:
μοιχεύω
(μοιχός), [in LXX: Êx 20:13, Lv 20:10, al. (נָאַף) ;]
to commit adultery: absol., Mt 5:27 19:18, Mc 10:19, Lc 16:18 18:20, Rm 2:22 13:9, Tg 2:11; with accusative fem., Mt 5:28. Pass., of the woman, Mt 5:32 19:9 WH, mg.), Jo 8:4. Metaphorical, of idolatry (see: μιοιχαλίς, and cf. Jr 3:9, a1.), before μετ᾽ αὐτῆς, Ap 2:22.†
(AS)

G3432.def:
μοιχός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for נָאַף ;]
an adulterer: Lc 18:11, 1Co 6:9, Hb 13:4.†
(AS)

G3433.def:
μόλις
adv. (μόλος, toil)
post-Hom. alternative for μόγις,
[in LXX: Pv 11:31, Wis.9:16, al. ;]
with difficulty, hardly, scarcely: Lc 9:39 (T, μόγις), At 14:8 27:7-8, 16, Rm 5:7, 1Pe 4:18" (LXX) .†
(AS)

G3434.def:
Μολόχ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מֶלֶךְ, prop. מֶלֶךְ King, but vocalized to read בֺּשֶׁת, shame, of. Βάαλ, and see DB, iii, 415 f.),
Moloch, the god of the Ammonites : At 7:43 (LXX).†
(AS)

G3435.def:
μολύνω
[in LXX: Gn 37:31 (טָבַל), Is 59:3 (גָּאַל ni.), Zc 14:2 (שָׁכַב ni.), Sir.21:28, al. ;]
to stain, soil, defile; in NT always symb. and figuratively: 1Co 8:7, Ap 3:4 14:4.†
SYN.: μιαίνω, q.v (AS)

G3436.def:
μολυσμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(μολύνω), [in LXX: Jr 23:15 (חֲנֻפָה), I Et 8:83, 2Ma.5:27 * ;]
defilement: with genitive obj., 2Co 7:1 (Plut., FlJ).†
(AS)

G3437.def:
μομφή, ῆς, ἡ
(μέμφομαι),
poët. form of μέμψις,
blame, com­plaint: Cl 3:13.†
(AS)

G3438.def:
μονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(μένω), [in LXX: 1Ma.7:38 * ;]
__1. in cl.,
__(a) a staying, abiding;
__(b) continuance (LXX, 1 with)
__2. In late Gk.,
__(a) a statson (Paus.);
__(b) an abode: Jo 14:2, 23;
__(with) a monastery (cf. MM, iii, xvi; so in MGr.).†
(AS)

G3439.def:
μονογενής, -ές
(μόνος, γένος), [in LXX: Jz 11:34, Sl 22:20 25:16 35:17 (יָחִיד), Tob.3:15 6:10, 14 8:17, Wis.7:22, Bar.4:16 * ;]
only, only begotten (DCG, ii, 281), of sons and daughters : Lc 7:12 8:42 9:38, Hb 11:17; of Christ, Jo 3:16, 18, 1Jo 4:9; μ. παρὰ πατρός, Jo 1:14; μ. θεός, Jo 1:18.†
(AS)

G3440.def:
μόνον, see: μόνος.
μόνος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for לְבַד ;]
__1. adj., alone, solitary, forsaken: with verb., Mt 14:23, Mc 6:47, Lc 9:36, al.; with pron., Mt 18:15, Mc 9:2, al.; with subst., Mc 9:8, Lc 4:8, al.; pleonast., οὐκ . . . εἰ μὴ μ., Mt 12:4, Lc 6:4, al.; attrib., only, (ὁ) μ. θεός, Jo 5:44 17:3, Rm 16:27, 1Tm 1:17, Ju 25.
__2. As adv.,
__(a) neut., (μόνον, alone, only: referring to verb or predic., Mt 9:21, Mc 5:36, Tg 1:22, al. (see Bl., §44, 2); οὐ (μὴ) μ., Gl 4:18, Tg 1:22; οὐ μ. . . . ἀλλά (Bl, §77, 13.3), At 19:26, 1Jo 5:6, al.; id. before καί (Bl., §81, 1.2), Rm 5:3 9:10, 2Co 8:19, al.;
__(b) κατὰ μόνας, alone (Bl., §44, 1), Mc 4:10, Lc 9:18.
(AS)

G3441.def:
μόνος, -η, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for לְבַד ;]
__1. adj., alone, solitary, forsaken: with verb., Mt 14:23, Mc 6:47, Lc 9:36, al.; with pron., Mt 18:15, Mc 9:2, al.; with subst., Mc 9:8, Lc 4:8, al.; pleonast., οὐκ . . . εἰ μὴ μ., Mt 12:4, Lc 6:4, al.; attrib., only, (ὁ) μ. θεός, Jo 5:44 17:3, Rm 16:27, 1Tm 1:17, Ju 25.
__2. As adv.,
__(a) neut., (μόνον, alone, only: referring to verb or predic., Mt 9:21, Mc 5:36, Tg 1:22, al. (see Bl., §44, 2); οὐ (μὴ) μ., Gl 4:18, Tg 1:22; οὐ μ. . . . ἀλλά (Bl, §77, 13.3), At 19:26, 1Jo 5:6, al.; id. before καί (Bl., §81, 1.2), Rm 5:3 9:10, 2Co 8:19, al.;
__(b) κατὰ μόνας, alone (Bl., §44, 1), Mc 4:10, Lc 9:18.
(AS)

G3442.def:
μον-όφθαλμος, -ον
(μόνος),
Ionic and κοινή,
one-eyed, having one eye: Mt 18:9, Mc 9:47.†
(AS)

G3443.def:
μονόω, -ῶ
(μόνος), [in Aq.: Gn 49:6 ;]
to leave alone, forsake: of a childless widow, pf. ptcp. pass., 1Tm 5:5.†
(AS)

G3444.def:
μορφή, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX: Jz 8:18 A (תֹּאַר), Jó 4:16 (תְּמוּנָה), Is 44:13 (תַּבְנִית), Dan LXX 3:19 (צֶלֶם), Da TH Dn 4:33 5:6, 9-10 7:28 (זִיו), Tob.1:13, Wis.18:1, 4Ma.15:4 * ;]
form, shape, appearance (Hom., Eur., . sch., al.); in philos. lang. the specific character or essential form (Arist., see Gifford, Inc., 26 ff.) : Mc 16:12, Fp 2:6-7.†
SYN.: μόρφωσις, the outline, delineation, semblance of the μορφή, as distinct from the μ. itself (Lft., Notes, 262); σχῆμα, shape, fashion, disting. from μορφή as the outward and accidental from the inward and essential (cf. Tr., Syn., § LXX; Lft., Phi., 125 ff.; Gifford., Inc., l.with) (AS)

G3445.def:
μορφόω, -ῶ
(μορφή), [in Aq.: Is 44:13 * ;]
to form: figuratively, Gl 4:19 (cf. μετα-, συμ-μορφόω)
(AS)

G3446.def:
μόρφωσις, -εως, ἡ
(μορφόω),
__1. a forming, shaping (Theophr.).
__2. form, outline, semblance: Rm 2:20; opposite to δύναμις, 2Tm 3:5.†
SYN.: μορφή (which see), σχῆμα (AS)

G3447.def:
μοσχο-ποιέω, -ῶ
to make a calf (as an image) : At 7:41 (LXX, ἐποίησε μόσχον).†
(AS)

G3448.def:
μόσχος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for פַּר, also for שׁוֹר, עֵגֶל. etc. ;]
__1. a young shoot or twig.
__2. ὁ, ἡ, μ., offspring;
__(a) of men;
__(b) of animals; most frequently (as always in LXX), a calf, bullock, heifer: Lc 15:23, 27 15:30, Hb 9:12, 19 Ap 4:7.†
(AS)

G3449.def:
μόχθος, -ου, ὁ
(= Hom. μόγος), in cl. chiefly poët., [in LXX for תְּלָאָה, עָמָל, etc. ;]
toil, labour, hardship, distress: 2Co 11:27, 1Ts 2:9, 2Ts 3:8.†
SYN.: κόπος (which see), πόνος (AS)

G3451.def:
μουσικός, -ή, -όν
[in LXX: Gn 31:27, Eze.26:13 (שִׁיר), Dan LXX TH Dn 3:5 ff. (זְמָר), Sir.22:6, al. ;]
skilled in the arts, esp. in music; as subst., ὁ μ., a minstrel, musician: Ap 18:22.†
(AS)

G3452.def:
μυελός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX: Gn 45:18 (חֶלֶב), Jó 21:24 (מֹחַ) Jó 33:24 * ;]
marrow: Hb 4:12.†
(AS)

G3453.def:
μυέω, -ῶ
(μύω, to shut the mouth), [in LXX: 3Ma.2:30 * ;]
to initiate into the mysteries (so chiefly in cl.; LXX, l.with); hence, to instruct: pass., Fp 4:12 (RV, I have learned the secret).†
(AS)

G3454.def:
μῦθος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: Wis.17:4 A, Sir.20:19 * ;]
__1. speech, con­versation.
__2. (a) a story, narrative (Hom.);
__(b) later, opposite to λόγος (a true narrative) = Lat. fabula, a myth, fable, fiction: 1Tm 1:4 4:7, 2Tm 4:4, Tt 1:14, 2Pe 1:16.†
SYN.. λόγος, q.v (AS)

G3455.def:
μυκάσμαι, -ῶμαι in cl. chiefly poët.,
[in Sm.: Jó 6:5 * ;]
prop., of oxen (onomatop.), to low, bellow; of a lion, to roar: Ap 10:3.†
(AS)

G3456.def:
μυκτηρίζω
(μυκτήρ, the nose), [in LXX: 4Ki.19:21, Jó 22:19, Sl 80:6, al. (לָעַג), Pv 1:30 (נָאַץ) Pv 15:20 (בָּזָה), 1Ma.7:34, al. ;]
to turn up the nose or sneer at, mock: pass., Gl 6:7 (cf. ἐκ-μυκτηρίζω).†
(AS)

G3457.def:
μυλικός, -ή, -όν
(μύλη, a mill),
of a mill: λίθος μ., Lc 17:2.†
(AS)

G3458.def:
μύλος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for רֵחֶה, Nm 11:8, Dt 24:6, al. ;]
__1. = μύλη, a mill (Strab., Plut., LXX) : Mt 24:41, Ap 18:22.
__2. a mill-stone (Anth.) : Ap 18:21 (T); μ. ὀνικός, Mt 18:6, Mc 9:42 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G3460.def:
Μύρα, Μύρρα (LT, Tr., WH), -ων, τά,
Myra, a city of Lycia : At 27:5.†
(AS)

G3461.def:
μυριάς, -άδος, ἡ
(μυρίος), [in LXX chiefly for רְבָבָה ;]
ten thousand, a myriad: pl., At 19:19, Ap 5:11 9:16; hyperb., of vast numbers, Lc 12:1, At 21:20, Hb 12:12, Ju 14.†
(AS)

G3462.def:
μυρίζω
(μύρον),
Ionic and poët. (comic),
to anoint: Mc 14:8.†
SYN.: see: ἀλείφω, and cf. μύρον (AS)

G3463.def:
μυρίος, -α, -ον
__1. numberless, countless, infinite: 1Co 4:15 14:19.
__2. As a definite numeral, in pl., μύριοι, -αι, -α, ten thousand: Mt 18:24.†
(AS)

G3464.def:
μύρον, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁמֶן, Pv 27:9, Sl 133:2, al. ;]
ointment: Mt 26:7, 12, Mc 14:3-5, Lc 7:37-38, 46 23:56, Jo 11:2 12:3, 5, Ap 18:13.†
SYN.: ἔλαιον, q.v (AS)

G3465.def:
Μυσία, -ας, ἡ
Mysia, a province of Asia Minor: At 16:7-8.†
(AS)

G3466.def:
μυστήρισν, -ου, τό
(μυέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX TH Dn 2:18 ff. (רָז), Tob.12:7, 11, Jdth.2:2, Wis.2:22 6:22 14:15, 23, Sir.3:18 22:22 27:16-17, 21, 2Ma.13:21 * ;]
__1. that which is known to the μύστης (initiated), a mystery or secret doctrine, mostly in pl., τὰ μ. (Æsch., Hdt., al.).
__2. In later writers (Menand., Incert., 168), that which may not be revealed (not, however, as in the modern sense, intrinsically difficult to understand), a secret or mystery of any kind (To, Jth, 2Mac, ll, with).
__3. In NT, of the counsels of God (cf. Th.: Jó 15:8, Sl 25:14 for סוֹד), once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof;
__(a) of the Christian revelation generally : Rm 16:25, 1Co 2:7, Cl 1:26-27, Ef 3:3, 9; τ. βασιλείας τ. θεοῦ, Mc 4:11; τ. θεοῦ, 1Co 2:1, Ap 10:7; τ. θ., Χριστοῦ, Cl 2:2; τ. Χριστοῦ., Cl 4:3, Ef 3:4; τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, Ef 1:9; τ. εὐαγγελίον, Ef 6:19; τ. πίστεως, 1Tm 3:9; τ. εὐσεβείας, 1Tm 3:16;
__(b) of particular truths, or details, of the Christian revelation : Rm 11:25, 1Co 15:51, Ef 5:32, 2Ts 2:7, Ap 1:20 17:5, 7; pl., τὰ μ., 1Co 13:2 14:2; θεοῦ, 1Co 4:1; τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν (θεοῦ), Mt 13:11, Lc 8:10 (cf. Westc., Eph., 180 ff.; AR, Eph., 234 ff.; Lft., Col., 165 f.; Hatch, Essays, 57 f.; DB, iii, 465 ff.; DCG, ii, 213 ff.).†
(AS)

G3467.def:
μυ-ωπάζω
(μύωψ, closing the eyes, short-sighted; μύω, ὤψ)
to be short-sighted: 2Pe 1:9 (R, mg., closing his eyes; see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

G3468.def:
μώλωψ, -ωπος, ὁ
[in LXX for חַבּוּרָה, Êx 21:25, al. ;]
a bruise, wound from a stripe: 1Pe 2:24 (LXX) (Arist., Plut., al.).†
(AS)

G3469.def:
μωμάομαι, -ῶμαι
(μῶμος),
poët. and late prose,
[in LXX: Pv 9:7 (מאוּם), Wis.10:14, Sir.31:18 * ;]
to find fault with, blame: 2Co 8:20; pass., 2Co 6:3.†
(AS)

G3470.def:
μῶμος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX, of physical blemishes : Lv 21:17 ff., Dt 15:21, Ct 4:7, al. (מאוּם); of mental defect, Sir.20:24, al. ;]
__1. in cl. poets and late prose, blame, disgrace.
__2. In LXX, perb. because of resemblance to a physical blemish (cf. ἄμωμος, 1Pe 1:19, and see Hort., in l); metaphorically, of licentious persons, 2Pe 2:13.†
(AS)

G3471.def:
μωραίνω
(μωρός), [in LXX: Is 19:11, Jr 10:14 51:17 (בָּעַר ni.), 2Rs 24:10, Is 44:25 R (שָׂכַל ni., pi.)* ;]
__1. cl., to be foolish, play the fool.
__2. LXX and NT, causal, to make foolish: 1Co 1:20; pass., to become foolish: Rm 1:22; of salt that has lost its flavour, become tasteless: Mt 5:13, Lc 14:34.†
(AS)

G3474.def:
μωρός, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for נָבָל, etc.; frequently in Sir. ;]
__1. prop., of the nerves, dull, sluggish (Hipp., Arist.).
__2. Of the mind, dull, stupid, foolish: Mt 5:22 (see Field, Notes, 3 ff.) Mt 7:26 23:17, 19 (T, WH, txt., R, om.) Mt 25:2-3, 8, 1Co 3:18 4:10; of things, παράδοσις, Mc 7:13 (T, WH, txt., R, om.) : ζητήσεις, 2Tm 2:23, Tt 3:9; τὸ μ. τ. θεοῦ, 1Co 1:25; τὰ μ. τ. κόσμου, 1Co 1:27.†
(AS)

G3475.def:
Μωυσῆς (Μωϋσῆς, T; Μωσῆς, Rec.), -έως, dative - (as LXX: Êx 5:20, al.), and -εῖ, accusative -ῆν (ac LXX) and -έα (Lc 16:29 only) (Heb. מֹשֶׁה),
Moses: Mt 8:4 17:3-4, al.; νόμος Μωυσέως, Lc 2:22 24:44, Jo 7:23, At 13:39 15:5 28:23, 1Co 9:9, Hb 10:28; by meton., of the books of Moses, Lc 16:29 24:27, At 15:21, 2Co 3:15
(AS)

G3478.def:
Ναζαρά
(Mt 4:13­ L, -άθ­Lc 4:16)
Ναζαρέθ (Mt 21:11, At 10:38),
Ναζαρέτ (so always Rec.; WH, in foll, instances, where -έθ, T), ἡ,
indecl. (Semitic form uncertain),
Nazareth: Mt 2:23, Mc 1:9, Lc 1:26 2:4, 39 2:51, Jo 1:45-46.†
(AS)

G3479.def:
Ναζαρηνός, -οῦ, ὁ
(on the Semitic form, see Dalman, Gr., 141 n.)
a Nazarene: Mc 1:24 10:47 14:67 16:6, Lc 4:34 24:19.†
(AS)

G3480.def:
Ναζωραῖος, -ου, ὁ
(= -ρηνός, which see),
a Nazarene: Mt 2:23 (LXX) Mt 26:71, Lc 18:37, Jo 18:5, 7 19:19, At 2:22 3:6 4:10 6:14 22:8 24:5 26:9.†
(AS)

G3482.def:
Ναθαναήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. נְתַנְאֵל),
Nathaniel, prob. to be identified with Bartholomew (which see): Jo 1:45-49 21:2.†
(AS)

G3483.def:
ναί
particle of affirmation,
yea, verily, even so; in answer to a question: Mt 9:28 13:51 17:25 21:16, Jo 11:27 21:15-16, At 5:8 22:27, Rm 3:29; before λέγω ὑμῖν, Mt 11:9, Lc 7:26; repeated for emphasis, ναὶ ναί (opposite to oὒ oὔ): Mt 5:37; ἤτω ὑμῶν τὸ ναὶ ναί, Tg 5:12; ν. καὶ οὔ, 2Co 1:18-19; ἵνα ᾖ . . . τὸ ναὶ ναί, 2Co 1:17; τὸ ν., 2Co 1:20; in assent to an assertion: Mt 15:27, Mc 7:28, Ap 14:13 16:7; in confirmation of a previous assertion: Mt 11:26, Lc 10:21 11:51 12:5, Fp 4:3, Phm 20; in solemn asseveration Ap 1:7 22:20.†
(AS)

G3484.def:
Ναίν (Rec. Ναΐν), ἡ, indecl. (Heb. נָאָה),
Nain, a village of Galilee: Lc 7:11.†
(AS)

G3485.def:
ναός, -οῦ, ὁ
(Att.. νεώς; ναίω, to inhabit), [in LXX (νεώς, 2Ma.6:2, al.) chiefly for הֵיכָל ;]
__1. a temple (Hom., Find., al.).
__2. The inmost part of a temple, the shrine (Hat., Xen., al.); in NT,
__(a) generally: pl., At 17:24; of silver models of a heathen shrine, At 19:24;
__(b) of the temple building proper, or sanctuary, at Jerusalem, as distinct from τ. ἱερόν (which see), the whole temple enclosure: Mt 23:16-17, 35 27:5, 40, Mc 14:58 15:29 Jo 2:19-20, Ap 11:2; (τοῦ) θεοῦ, Mt 26:61 27:51, Mc 15:38, Lc 1:9, 21-22 23:45, 1Co 3:17, 2Co 6:16, 2Ts 2:4, Ap 11:1; of the temple in the Apocal. visions, Ap 3:12 7:15 11:19 14:15, 17 15:5-6, 8 16:1, 17 21:22 a. Metaphorical, of Christians, 1Co 3:16 6:19, 2Co 6:16, Ef 2:21; of Christ's body, Jo 2:21 (cf. Jo 2:19); ὁ θεὸς ν. αὐτῆς ἐστιν, Ap 21:22 b.†
SYN.: ἱερόν (AS)

G3487.def:
νάρδος, -ου, ἡ
(Heb. נֵרְדְּ, both from Sanscrit narda, see Boisacq, see word), [in LXX: Ct 1:12 4:13-14 (נֵרְדְּ)* ;]
nard;
__(a) an Indian plant, the Nardostachys nardus jatamansi, used for the preparation of a fragrant ointment;
__(b) ointment of nard: Mc 14:3, Jo 12:3.†
(AS)

G3488.def:
the narcissus , (Homeric Hymns), etc.
From ναρκάω, because of its narcotic properties. (ML)

G3489.def:
ναυαγέω, -ῶ
(ναῦς, + ἄγνυμι, to break)
to suffer shipwreck: 2Co 11:25; metaphorically, before περὶ τ. πίστιν, 1Tm 1:19.†
(AS)

G3491.def:
ναῦς, νεώς accusative ναῦν, ἡ,
[in LXX for עָנִי, אֲנִיָּה ;]
a ship: At 27:41 (elsewhere in NT always τ. πλοῖον; see M, Pv 25:1-28 f.; Bl., Gosp., 186 f.).†
(AS)

G3492.def:
ναύτης, -ου, ὁ
(ναῦς), [in Aq.: Eze.27:9; Sm.: Eze.27:29 * ;]
a seaman, sailor: At 27:27, 30, Ap 18:17.†
(AS)

G3494.def:
νεανίας, -ου, ὁ
(νεάν = νέος) [in LXX for נַעַר, בָּחוּר ;]
a young man: At 7:58 20:9 23:17-18.†
(AS)

G3495.def:
νεανίσκος, -ου, ὁ
(dimin. of νεανίας) [in LXX chiefly for נַעַר, also for בָּחוּר, etc. ;]
a young man, youth: Mt 19:20, 22, Mc 14:51 16:5, Lc 7:14, At 2:17" (LXX) At 23:18, 22, 1Jo 2:13-14; of an attendant (cf. Gn 14:24, al.) : At 5:10.†
(AS)

G3498.def:
νεκρός, -α, -ον,
[in LXX chiefly for מֵת ;]
dead,
__I. as adj.,
__1. prop.: At 5:10 20:9, Tg 2:26, Ap 1:18, al.; ὡσεὶ ν., Mt 28:4, Mc 9:26, Ap 1:17; of that which is subject to death, Rm 8:10.
__2. Metaphorical,
__(a) of persons: Lc 15:24, 32; of those immersed in worldly cares, Mt 8:22, Lc 9:60; of spiritual death, Jo 5:25, Rm 6:13, Ef 5:14, Ap 3:1; τ. παραπτώμασιν, Ef 2:1, 5 Cl 2:13; of the opposite condition, ν. τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, Rm 6:11;
__(b) of things regarded as inoperative, devoid of power: ἁμαρτία, Rm 7:8; πίστις, Tg 2:17, 26; ἔργα, Hb 6:1 9:14.
__II. As subst., νεκρός, ὁ (Hom., al.), chiefly in pl. (οἱ) ν., the dead: Mt 11:5, Mc 12:26, Lc 20:37, 1Co 15:15, al.; ἀνάστασις (τ.) νεκρῶν, Mt 22:31, At 17:32, al.; ν. . . . ζῶντες, Mt 22:32, Mc 12:27, At 10:42, al.; ἀπὸ νεκρῶν, Lc 16:30; ἐκ ν., Mc 6:14, Lc 24:46, Jo 12:1, At 13:34, Rm 10:7, al.; πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν ν., Cl 1:18; ζωὴ ἐκ ν., Rm 11:15; constr. praegn., ἐκ ν. ζῶντες, Rm 6:13.
(AS)

G3499.def:
νεκρόω, ῶ
(νεκρός),
to make dead, put to death; pass., to be dead: hyperbolically, of impotent age, Hb 11:12; σῶμα, Rm 4:19. Trop., of carnal impulses, τὰ μέλη, Cl 3:5.†
(AS)
